ExportKindExtension.text: The extension of the files of a kind: '.png' for the bitmaps and '.svg' for the vector kinds (CDlgExportPNG::getExtension gives '.png' or '.emf').

ExportKindIsSvg.text: Tells the vector kinds from the bitmaps; the scale and the turn do nothing to an SVG.

ExportKindIsBlackWhite.text: Tells the black and white kinds from the colour ones.
ExportKindIsBlackWhite.returns: True for the black and white kinds

TfrmExportImage.FileName.text: The file the picture is written to, as typed (without spaces at its ends).

TfrmExportImage.Kind.text: The kind of picture chosen in the list.
TfrmExportImage.Kind.returns: 0 colour PNG, 1 B&W PNG, 2 colour SVG, 3 B&W SVG

TfrmExportImage.Scale.text: The scale typed in the Scale box.
TfrmExportImage.Scale.returns: the scale in per cent, 0 when the box holds no whole number

TfrmExportImage.Rotate.text: Whether the Rotate box is ticked.
TfrmExportImage.Rotate.returns: True when a PNG is to be turned a quarter turn
